# Kone AI

> Specialized neural architectures, cognitive automation agents, and domain-adapted machine learning research by Kone Academy.

Kone AI investigates and implements production-grade artificial intelligence systems, multi-agent workflows, computer vision pipelines, and intelligent decision systems across the 11 divisions of the Kone ecosystem.

## Research Verticals & Capabilities

- **Domain-Specialized LLM Orchestration**: Context-grounded language models with structured tool calling (WebMCP).
- **Computer Vision Diagnostics**: Real-time OpenCV telemetry pipelines for vehicle obstacle detection (Kone Warp) and multispectral crop analysis (Kone Farms).
- **Industrial Reinforcement Learning**: Adaptive control loops for solar micro-irrigation valves and smart IoT grid management (Kone Lab).
- **Interactive Mission Simulation**: Multi-scenario agentic problem-solving sandbox with dynamic telemetry simulation.

## Parent Ecosystem & Federated Links

- [Kone Academy (Hub)](https://www.koneacademy.io/): Central learning portal and technology group.
- [Kone Technologies (Parent)](https://konetech.koneacademy.io/): Corporate holding organization.
- [Kone Code (Engineering)](https://code.koneacademy.io/): Backend model serving, APIs, and web infrastructure.
- [Kone Lab (Hardware)](https://lab.koneacademy.io/): Edge ML inference on micro-controllers and embedded sensors.
- [Kone Farms (Agritech)](https://farms.koneacademy.io/): Predictive crop yield modeling and soil moisture forecasting.
- [Kone Warp (Mobility)](https://warp.koneacademy.io/): Autonomous routing algorithms and computer vision diagnostics.
- [Kone Consult (Research)](https://consult.koneacademy.io/): Theoretical statistical models and academic publication.
